resources.string: Bori stays with you on your home screen and over other apps. Drag to move, or hide and stop from the notification. Bori rests while your phone is locked.
Allow notifications to keep Bori’s hide and stop controls close by. Tap Show Bori to continue.
Bori is hidden. Show Bori to bring your companion back.
Bori is resting until you unlock your phone.
Bori could not wake up. Please reopen the app.
To show Bori, allow Roamling to display over other apps in Settings.
Overlay settings are unavailable on this device.
Bori could not appear. Check the display permission and try again.
Bori is here. Touch and drag to move.
